title: 算 Step 5 · Boss Level: 小林 Splits the Hotpot Bill
description: Four friends, one hotpot, a discount and a bill to split. Every kind of calculation in one dinner.

points.title: Reading numbers in a story
points.summary: Spot the operation: 一共 (+), 还剩 (−), 打折 (×), 平均分 (÷).
points.body:
Follow the money.

| | say | example |
|---|---|---|
| **+** | 加 jiā | 三**加**五**等于**八 (3 + 5 = 8) |
| **−** | 减 jiǎn | 十**减**四等于六 (10 − 4 = 6) |
| **×** | 乘 / 乘以 chéng(yǐ) | 六**乘以**七等于四十二 |
| **÷** | 除以 chúyǐ | 十**除以**二等于五 · ⚠️ 二**除**十 = 10 ÷ 2 too! |
| **=** | 等于 děngyú | (spoken: 是) |
| **¾** | 四**分之**三 — bottom number first | 二分之一 = ½ |
| **3.5 · 20% · −5** | 三**点**五 · **百分之**二十 · **负**五 | 0.08 = 零点零八 |
| **×2 · 20% off** | 两**倍** · 打**八折** (pay 80%) | 增加了一倍 = doubled |

points.title: Final mixed challenge
points.body:

| | say | example |
|---|---|---|
| **+** | 加 jiā | 三**加**五**等于**八 (3 + 5 = 8) |
| **−** | 减 jiǎn | 十**减**四等于六 (10 − 4 = 6) |
| **×** | 乘 / 乘以 chéng(yǐ) | 六**乘以**七等于四十二 |
| **÷** | 除以 chúyǐ | 十**除以**二等于五 · ⚠️ 二**除**十 = 10 ÷ 2 too! |
| **=** | 等于 děngyú | (spoken: 是) |
| **¾** | 四**分之**三 — bottom number first | 二分之一 = ½ |
| **3.5 · 20% · −5** | 三**点**五 · **百分之**二十 · **负**五 | 0.08 = 零点零八 |
| **×2 · 20% off** | 两**倍** · 打**八折** (pay 80%) | 增加了一倍 = doubled |

questions.translation: At the weekend Xiao Lin and three friends went for hotpot. They ordered 360 kuai of food altogether. The owner said: 'Ten per cent off today!' After the discount it was 324 kuai. The four of them split it equally — 81 kuai each. Xiao Lin had brought 100 kuai, so after paying he had 19 left. One friend said: 'Next time it's my treat — you only pay half!' ★ Each person paid 90 kuai.

questions.prompt: Which operation answers each question about the story?
questions.explanation: 一共 → 加 · 还剩 / 便宜了 → 减 · 打折 → 乘 · 平均 / 每 → 除.
三百六十**乘以零点九**等于三百二十四。

questions.prompt: Next time they only pay half of 81 块 each. How much is that?
questions.explanation: 八十一的**一半** = 八十一除以二 = **四十点五** (40.5).
notes: That's 4.5 — a tenth of the answer.
questions.translation: Next time they pay half of 81 kuai each.
